newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - off, but coming back.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - off, but coming back.

text.p: U.S. municipal bond prices were off about 1/8, but appear to be making a slight comeback on strengthening in the U.S. Treasury market.
In the government cash market, the benchmark 30-year bond was up 6/32 at 95-21/32 to yield 6.97 percent at 1335 EST.
"We were off about 1/4 to 1/8, but coming back now," said one trader. "We are now unchanged to down 1/8," he estimated.
Secondary activity was light light and there was relatively light primary sales calendar activity for Thursday.
In debt futures, the June municipal contract was up 6/32 at 113-6/32. The June T-bond contract was up 4/32 at 108-20/32. The MOB spread was 146 ticks.

Goldman Sachs & Co tentatively repriced $90 million Connecticut Housing Finance Authority bonds,raising the yield to 6.20 percent from 6.15 percent in 2028. To see the preliminary pricing, please double click on nN20253763.
In the competitive sector, a $282 million Ohio education bond issue was won by Goldman Sachs with a true interest cost of 5.06 percent, nN2066927.
And Goldman Sachs won a $45 million of Wisconsin general obligation bonds with a true interest cost of 5.97 percent, nN20274424.
